notes: Employees by state are from Boeing's 'December 2025 Employment by Location' table on boeing.com/company, which matches the FY2025 year end; no newer edition found (checked 2026-11-24: the page still shows December 2025). It includes Spirit AeroSystems (acquisition completed Dec 8, 2025), which raises Kansas. The table names 10 states; 'Other U.S. States' (15,323) is an aggregate and is not mapped; 'Global' (25,371) is the non-U.S. total. The FY2025 10-K says the workforce was approximately 182,000 at Dec 31, 2025 with 14% outside the U.S.; nothing was derived from that split. Supplier spend by state: Boeing's per-state 'state cards' (boeing.com/.../state_cards/Card_XX.pdf) returned 404 for every state in the earlier research (not rechecked in this refresh), and the U.S. page gives only national figures, so no state supplier-spend rows are recorded. Sites: corporate HQ from the FY2025 10-K cover; the eight state 'key sites' cards from Boeing's U.S. page (still live, checked 2026-11-24) are state-level descriptions, not single facilities. The 10-K's Item 2 lists major locations (e.g. Greater Seattle, Wichita, Greater Charleston, Greater St. Louis) without figures.
